about_the_game:
This downloadable content includes a single avatar fully compatible with Animaze, featuring both ARKit-based and standard facial tracking support.

Zyntheris is a fully customizable furry character that combines fox-like and wolf-like features. This avatar was created for the ex-FaceRig community and is designed to help you express your personality with precision and style in any virtual space.

You can change the colors, add props like hats, glasses, headphones, and customize the look to match your own style. Zyntheris offers high facial mobility, clear and dynamic expressions, and smooth animations.

It works perfectly in Animaze for streaming, video chats, games, and virtual meetings. Zyntheris is a great choice if you want to bring your imagination to life, express yourself creatively, and stand out in the virtual world.

Features

  • Facial Animations
    Includes a standard set of facial animations for use with the Mediapipe tracker, as well as an ARKit-specific set designed for iPhone tracking. Both options provide smooth, expressive facial performance.

  • Color Customizations
    Every part of the avatar supports extensive color customization, offering users full creative freedom to match their personal style.

  • Props Attachment Slots
    Equipped with slots for a wide variety of props, including:

    • Hat

    • Mustache

    • Earphones

    • Glasses

    • Holdables

    • Carryables

  • Hand Tracking
    Supports all 70 hand animations for detailed and natural hand movements.

  • Full Body Tracking
    Compatible with Axis Neuron for full-body tracking, ensuring dynamic and lifelike performance.

  • Special Actions
    Features special actions retargeted from Animaze’s mannequin, enhancing the character’s versatility.

  • Fur Component
    Includes a stylized fur component for added visual depth and charm.

Includes one background with light setup: The world of Luminara

This avatar content is developed by a third-party art team and will only be available in the Steam Live Service version of Animaze,  to Steam users who have purchased this DLC. It will not be included by default in any historical snapshot of Animaze, and it will not be available outside of Steam.
